user.title: SOSSEN Microinverter
user.description:
How do you want to set up your inverter?

⚠️ **The inverter must be powered during setup** (producing from sun or battery). Allow 2-3 minutes after setup before data appears.

menu_options.smart_life: Smart Life login (recommended: no key or IP to type)

smart_life.title: Smart Life login
smart_life.description:
Enter your **user code** from the Smart Life (or Home Power) app: **Me → ⚙️ Settings → Account and Security → User Code**. The app is used only now, to read your inverters and their keys: afterwards everything stays on your local network.

{msg}

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.description: In the Smart Life app, tap the scan icon (top right of the home screen), scan this code and confirm the login. Then press **Submit**.

pick.title: Inverters found
pick.description: {count} SOSSEN inverter(s) found in your account. Choose the ones to add.

addresses.title: Inverter not found on the network
addresses.description: Not found: **{names}**. Make sure it is powered and on the same network as Home Assistant, then enter its IP address (see your router's DHCP list).

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description:
Enter the details of your SOSSEN inverter.

⚠️ **The inverter must be powered during setup** (producing from sun or battery). Allow 2-3 minutes after setup before data appears.

data_description.model: Family of your inverter: number of panel inputs and maximum power
data_description.device_ip: Leave empty to find it on the network automatically
data_description.device_id: Smart Life app → Settings → Device Information → Device ID
data_description.local_key: From Tuya IoT Platform → Devices → Local Key
data_description.poll_interval: How often to poll the inverter (minimum 5 seconds)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the inverter. Check IP, Device ID and Local Key.
error.login_error: The Smart Life login failed: check the user code. {msg}
error.scan_error: The QR code has not been scanned (or has expired): scan the new one, then press Submit.
error.not_found: Enter the IP address of each inverter listed.

abort.cloud_error: Could not read the devices of the Smart Life account. Try again later, or use the manual setup.
abort.no_inverters: No SOSSEN inverter found in this Smart Life account.

progress.locate: Looking for the inverters on your network (up to {seconds} s)…

init.title: Overvoltage protection
init.description: The inverter disconnects from the grid around 253 V, and its own production raises the voltage it sees. When enabled, every interval: at or above the high threshold the power limit goes down one step, at or below the low threshold it goes back up one (smaller) step, never above the limit you chose. Each change is a command sent to the inverter.

error.low_above_high: The low threshold must be below the high threshold.
